build_min_cov_det_estimator: build a MinCovDet robust covariance estimator fitted on contaminated data with outliers
create_empirical_covariance: create an EmpiricalCovariance estimator fitted on clean or contaminated datasets
run_robust_vs_empirical_comparison: run a comparison of robust MCD and empirical covariance estimation errors on contaminated Gaussian data
plot_covariance_estimation_errors: plot error bars comparing robust and empirical covariance estimation across outlier contamination levels
test_min_cov_det_error_norm: test the MinCovDet error_norm method to compute RMSE against a true covariance matrix
